data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. The current maximum expiration for public links is set for security best practices. While we don't plan to offer never expire options, we can consider extending the maximum duration. Please provide your specific use cases for longer expiration periods at roadmap.cloudesk.com/feature-requests/public-link-expiration. For permanent sharing, consider inviting users directly to a workspace. [T-5642] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
